verdict.rationale: The docs say sandboxes default to a 5-minute timeout, which can be set at creation and extended at runtime via `sandbox.extendTimeout()`. Persistence (on by default) auto-saves state on stop and resumes by name, so long agent work can span sessions even if the VM itself does not run continuously. Missing for 10: any documented maximum runtime showing a single session can actually stay up for hours or days, guidance on long-running agent sessions, and hands-on corroboration of multi-hour runs.
